reasoning_traces.think:
The core structure combines a hierarchical Bayesian model with James-Stein shrinkage to estimate team run totals. The model uses only pre-game team performance data, avoiding external variables like pitcher or weather. It is anchored to a specific null hypothesis—vig-inclusive rather than de-vigged—which ensures that claims of edge are grounded in realistic market prices. The e-process is asymmetrically gated by MVE certification and founder signature, ensuring that no retroactive adjustments can occur. The model’s parameters are frozen at time of pre-registration, preventing data snooping or post-hoc rationalization. The shrinkage mechanism reduces estimation variance by borrowing strength across teams, improving prediction accuracy under uncertainty. The model is evaluated against a fixed scoring window (6–3h pre-game), aligning with the timing of market entry and exit. This design enforces epistemic discipline by constraining both input space and temporal scope.
